purpose: Open-world location inventory for Paldea and DLC. Scarlet/Violet has no numbered routes; Pokémon and collectibles must be pinned to verified terrain locations, not route tables.
coordinatePolicy: Paldea is an open world with no numbered routes. Use terrain-based Pokémon spawn areas and verify every item, trainer, stake, Gimmighoul and raid pin against Scarlet/Violet and DLC.
